newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's exchange to boost domestic activity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's exchange to boost domestic activity.

text.p: Indonesia's capital markets supervisory body (Bapepam) plans to boost the role of domestic investors on the bourse by licensing more mutual funds, the Jakarta Post daily reported on Thursday.

"We will urge our local investors to become more active in the capital market. I think one thing we can do to activate the local investors is to encourage the formation of more mutual funds," Bapepam's chairman I Putu Gede Ary Suta was quoted as saying.
This year saw a very rapid growth in the number of mutual funds, he said.
"Last year we only had one mutual fund - the BDNI mutual fund. But as of December 23 we now have 22 mutual funds with a total net asset value of 2.28 trillion rupiah," Putu said.
He said the agency was processing applications for five more funds.
The agency also noted in 1996 the role of local investors had increased although foreign investors remained dominant in overall trading on Indonesia's stock markets
Putu said in 1996 foreign investors accounted for 60.18 percent of total trade, compared with 67.03 percent the previous year.
He said total funds raised through Indonesia's capital market from January to December 23 reached 16.28 trillion rupiah.
The total funds raised through 19 Initial Public Offerings, 13 bonds issuance and 36 rights issue were 2.66 trillion rupiah, 2.84 trillion rupiah and 10.78 trillion respectively.
He also said the trading volume on the Jakarta Stock Exchange (JSX) from January to December 23 increased 171.9 percent to 29 billion shares from 10.6 billion shares in 1995.
The trading volume on the Surabaya Stock Exchange (SSX) was down 10.5 percent to 1.5 billion shares from 1.7 billion shares last year, he said.

Putu said the JSX trading value rose 130.1 percent to 74.44 trillion rupiah from 32.36 trillion rupiah last year, while SSX's trading value declined 22.7 percent to 4.06 trillion rupiah from 5.25 trillion rupiah in the previous year.
